items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah I had an experience like that with a casino here and they had this act called “The Rat Pack” and they did Sinatra and Dean Martin.

ctx.x: Oh okay. And I got off the road and got into Charlie Haden and another story and everything. One day I guess they were in a panic, they didn’t have a keyboard player, could I come down, it’d be great to see you. So I went down to whatever gig it was in Orange County in L.A. and it was like a racetrack I think, whatever it was. And we went up and there was the brass players and everything and I’m looking for the string section. And I was the guy that had to sit at the synthesizer playing my string charts. And it…

Yeah I had an experience like that with a casino here and they had this act called “The Rat Pack” and they did Sinatra and Dean Martin. And the whole thing was played on three keyboards. And it actually was difficult trying to re-create these things and not frown at the same time.
